# Academify

> Academify is a B2B computer-based testing (CBT) platform for schools,
> coaching institutes, and Olympiad-conducting organizations. It covers the
> full exam cycle: question bank, test building, a secure student exam
> screen, remote proctoring, live monitoring, and finalized results.

## What Academify does

- **Question bank management**: questions organized by class, subject,
  topic, subtopic, and difficulty; MCQ, text, and match-the-column types;
  bulk upload from an Excel template.
- **Test builder**: multi-section tests with configurable marks, negative
  marking, and optional question/option shuffling; scheduled and published
  to a class, a section, or individual students.
- **Student exam screen**: mobile-responsive interface with section tabs, a
  question palette, Mark for Review, Clear Response, answers saved as the
  student goes, and auto-submit when time expires.
- **Proctoring and live monitoring**: periodic webcam snapshots with
  face-presence and multiple-face checks, fullscreen enforcement, tab-switch
  detection, and flags for dev tools, print-screen, page refresh, and
  network drops; a live monitor shows each candidate's status and violations.
- **Results and reports**: a Finalize Results workflow that computes cohort
  statistics and ranks; score distribution, section-wise breakdown, student
  ranking, per-student answer review with time spent, and Excel export.
- **Administration**: Super Admin, Admin, Teacher, and Student roles,
  per-role module visibility, bulk user upload from CSV, and institution
  logo branding.

## Audience

Academify sells to institutions, not individual consumers: schools,
coaching institutes, and organizations that conduct Olympiads or other
large-scale assessments for their students or member institutions.

Prospective institutional clients can request a demo via the contact page
above. Academify does not offer self-serve pricing or a consumer product.
